name: Methi Tofu Paratha
steps: Mix flour, tofu, methi, ajwain, cumin, chilli, turmeric, salt and ½ tsp oil.
Add water a little at a time and knead into a soft, pliable dough. Rest covered 10 minutes.
Divide into four balls. Roll each between lightly floured sheets into a small paratha.
Cook on a hot tawa, turning once bubbles appear. Brush each side lightly with oil.
Cook until brown spots appear and the centre is cooked. Serve with plain soy yogurt or raita.
note: Tofu adds moisture, so add water gradually. Vegan when served without dairy accompaniments.

inspirationReferences.title: Methi Paratha Recipe (Methi ke Parathe)
inspirationReferences.note: Fresh methi handling, dough mixing and tawa-roasting technique; tofu-stuffed adaptation is original.
